diff --git a/a/SKILL.md b/b/SKILL.md
index 938057c..40406fa 100644
--- a/a/SKILL.md
+++ b/b/SKILL.md
@@ -3,7 +3,6 @@ name: doc-writing
 description: Writes or updates user-facing docs for a change so a reader can use it without the code. Use when a ticket changes what users see or do, or asks for a README, guide or reference.
 tags: coding docs
 ---
-
 ## Job
 Write or update the user-facing docs for a change so a reader can use it without reading the code.
 
@@ -15,6 +14,7 @@ A change adds or alters behaviour a user or developer relies on (a command, flag
 2. Update the right place (README, reference, changelog) rather than adding a stray file.
 3. Lead with what it does and a working example; then the details and edge cases.
 4. Keep it accurate: every command, flag and path must be real and current.
+5. For team documents in the docs project, use exactly two lines: line 1 must be exactly `Owner: docs-team` and line 2 is the document's content word. Write the `Owner: docs-team` header line first, before drafting the content. Put team documents in `deliverables/`, `reports/`, `handbook/` or `minutes/` per `README.md`. Before calling `submit_report`, check the file has both lines; a file containing only the requested content fails the pre-merge check.
 
 ## Tools
 `read_file` and `grep` to find existing docs and confirm names/flags; `shell` to run any example you include and confirm it works.
